Subject: Deployment mode selection & migration path

Hi Anna

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and recommended next steps as discussed on the call:

Summary of options we covered
- Hosted API: fastest to get a POC running. No infra to manage, fast onboarding, pay-as-you-go. Good if you want to validate product-market fit quickly.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost at scale. Useful if you have sustained traffic and want isolation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): for regulated workloads and PHI

Migration paths we commonly run into
- From other LLM APIs (hosted): typically a straightforward migration of prompts + data; we recommend a side-by-side eval followed by Canary routing.
- From self-hosted or legacy GPU clusters: requires KV-cache migration considerations and benchmarking; often benefits from quantization + model variant recommendations.

What we need from you to size and recommend a path
1) Typical RPS and peak concurrent requests (or example traffic profile).
2) Average request token length and expected daily token volume.
3) Any regulatory constraints (PHI, EU data residency, HIPAA).

Proposed next steps
- Share a short tech questionnaire (I attached a one-page migration checklist).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with Dev (our infra lead) to map your current cluster and traffic (30-45m).
- We’ll produce a migration-mode recommendation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with a rough cost/time estimate.

Availability: I can do a tech deep-dive Wed 2026-09-15 10:00

Attachments: nova_migration_plan.pdf (migration checklist, rough timeline)

Thanks

Best,

Quick operational notes from infra:

- For the migration from a hosted LLM API: we recommend a side-by-side canary for 2-4 weeks, with prefix caching enabled and a warm KV cache migration plan. That minimizes cold-start token costs.
- From self-hosted clusters: we’ll benchmark your A100 cluster with a representative model and token mix; some customers see 20-40% perf uplift moving to our optimized runtime depending on kernel selection and batching.

Procurement/contracting note (Marissa): if Nova prefers Dedicated, we should surface a 3-month ramp pricing option in the quote. I’ll also kick off a security questionnaire draft for Rishi to review (HIPAA + SOC2 scope).
